segments.text: Kazuma is the current head of the Maki family, one of the three great warrior clans. Known for their passionate spirit, the Maki warriors have passed this trait down through generations, and Kazuma embodies it fully. He serves as the vice-chairman of the Hokutokai (Sworn Blades), but refuses to acknowledge acting chairman Hotori’s authority, leaving the organization divided. Despite the disparity in military strength, Kazuma boldly calls for resistance, a stance that has earned him the admiration and loyalty of many young warriors.
武人三祖家の一角である槇家の現当主。槇家の武人は血気盛んであり、数馬も例外ではありません。現在は奉刀会の副会長を務めていますが、会長代行の滸を認めておらず、組織は分裂状態。戦力差を顧みずに決起を主張する数馬の豪胆さには、多くの若い武人が惹かれています。

segments.text: Like Elsa, he serves as a soldier of the Republic, and despite his youth, has already attained the rank of lieutenant. While attending Tenkyo Imperial Academy, he interacts with Sojin as a classmate. Well-versed in the culture of the Imperial Kingdom, he treats its citizens on equal terms with republicans. His friendly yet elusive personality often leaves others—especially Sojin—struggling to understand him, sometimes leading to trouble.
エルザと同じ共和国の軍人であり、若いながらも階級は中尉。天京帝立学院に通い、宗仁とは学友として交流しています。皇国の文化にとても詳しく、皇国人にも分け隔てなく接している模様。気さくな人柄ですが掴み所がなく、宗仁をしばしば困らせています。

He manages the Kojiya Flower Shop where Sojin works and is also Sojin's benefactor, having taken him in after his war injury. He used to be a Shinto priest but prefers not to discuss his past. He's so handsome that everyone envies him, and his fragile, sickly-looking appearance makes him popular with women. In reality, he is in perfect health except for his unfortunate liver.

segments.text: Warren, the governor-general of the Republican Army, oversees the Imperial Nation in the aftermath of the war. However, he shows little interest in actual governance, viewing the Imperial Nation merely as a tool to fulfill his personal desires. To him, war is nothing more than a means to expand his power and enrich himself—a greed that has earned him the deep resentment of his daughter, Elsa.
戦後の皇国を支配する共和国軍の総督。しかし、統治には興味がなく、ウォーレンにとって皇国は自らの欲望を満たすための存在にすぎません。戦争は権力・権益拡大ための手段と考えており、欲にまみれたウォーレンを娘であるエルザは軽蔑しています。

The last princess and heir to the throne of the empire. After the empire’s defeat she hides her identity and vows to strike back at those who harmed her mother. Even though she might be of royal birth, she still shows plenty of her emotions. She has a habit of crying when she’s happy or sad.
From Otaku Lair
In her route, she reclaimed the empire as the 88th empress, Toukatei (桃花帝).
先代皇帝の一人娘であり、最後に残された正統なる帝位継承者です。敗戦時の混乱のさなか、母親である皇帝は崩御するものの、彼女は辛うじて敵国の手を逃れました。その陰には、主人公・宗仁の獅子奮迅の働きがあったと言われています。戦後は身を守るため正体を隠し、王家を再興すべく臥薪嘗胆の日々を送ってきました。宗仁が通う学園に転校してきたことにも、何か目的があるようです。
生まれながらの高貴さを持ちながらも感情表現は豊か。上品かつ屈託のない笑顔には誰もが心を奪われます。嬉しくても悲しくても泣いてしまうタイプで、周囲にからかわれないよう必死に涙をこらえていることも。

In order to obtain funds for the activites of her father's organization, she works as an idol under the name "Natsumi" (菜摘) who is popular all around the nation. Only the officials of the organization know about her identity.

He is proficient in wielding a sword and serves as an assistant instructor at the dojo. Even without a lord to serve, he does not neglect his training. He is an honest warrior.

His actual identity is Mitsurugi (ミツルギ), a human-shaped magical weapon created by Himi no Mikoto at the sacrifice of 888 miko just before the final battle with Ko no Kuni (胡ノ国). Another identity is named Ame no Mitsurugi (天御剣), which is one of the Three Artifacts.

A young woman born to an Imperial father and a Republican mother. Her mannerisms are Republican in style, while her speech carries a neutral tone.
The heiress of one of the Imperial Nation’s most prominent conglomerates Kurushima zaibatsu, she now serves as its leader despite her youth.
Before the war, she spent some time in the Republic, during which she formed a friendship with Elsa.
Although her position in the postwar era is a delicate one, she navigates it with skill.
She has a habit of speaking in a theatrical manner, and in truth, finds it difficult to express her genuine feelings.
皇国を代表する財閥の跡取り娘として生まれ、現在は若くして総帥を務めています。父が皇国人で母が共和国人。戦前には共和国で過ごしていた時期もあり、その際にエルザと交誼を結びました。仕草は共和国風で、口調は中性的。戦後は難しい立場にありますが、上手く立ち回っています。
皇国人の父と、共和国人の母を持つ少女。 仕草は共和国風で口調は中性的。

「ごきげんよう……ああ、悪い。 これは共和国の挨拶だったか」

Although an Imperial citizen, she serves in the Republican Army under circumstances that remain entirely unknown. Often seen accompanying her superior officer, Rochelle, she appears to operate within a separate chain of command from regular soldiers. She is frequently observed entering and leaving Republican Army facilities, yet her true identity, role, and ultimate purpose remain shrouded in mystery.
Favorite: Cocoa mint cookies

Because she had committed acts of treachery against the Empire, it was believed that she could not escape a death sentence, and she had once resigned herself to dying. However, she was spared following the war through Kotone’s earnest petition.
She was appointed caretaker of the shrine dedicated to Kuroshu Ōkami, built in a quiet corner of the Imperial Sanctuary, and has since lived a life of peace.
Yet, believing it a waste to leave her unused talents, she was eventually summoned to participate in a certain national project.
皇国人でありながら共和国軍に所属していますが、経緯は一切不明。上官であるロシェルに付き従っていることが多く、通常の軍人とは違った指揮系統に属しているようです。共和国軍の研究施設に頻繁に出入りする姿が見られますが、目的や正体は謎に包まれています。
皇国人でありながら共和国軍に所属し、伊瀬野に攻め入るなど宗仁たちを追い詰めた人物。
皇国に仇なしたことから極刑は免れないと考えられており、本人も一度は生を諦めたが、戦後、古杜音の嘆願により助命される。
現在は、勅神殿の片隅に作られた《黒主大神》の社の責任者に任命され、静かに生きている。
その才を使わぬのはもったいないと、とある国家事業に狩り出されることに。
The treacherous prime minister who only thinks about his selfish gains without thinking about others.
In truth, he is the one supporting the country behind the shadows, knowing full well that it will only lead to his own death.

During the palace raid, the main party finally confronts Okonogi, where he tells them the truth that he never was corrupted and only followed the late queen's orders, and as a true warrior thought only about his country, sacrificing himself in the process.
共和国との戦争に際して皇国を裏切り、朱璃の母親である蘇芳帝を殺害した叛逆者。皇国が戦争に負けたのは、皇国全権を名乗る小此木が降伏文書に調印した瞬間でした。その後、小此木は奏海を傀儡皇帝に仕立て上げ、共和国総督ウォーレンの忠実な配下として皇国に圧政を敷いています。

The family head of the Inou house, Hotori's father, and the leader of the Sworn Blades, with the aim to free the Empire from the clutches of the Republic.
Over a year before the start of the story, he was captured during a rebellion attempt by the Republic, forcing the leadership role onto his daughter.
Unbeknowst to the Sworn Blades aiming to free him, he was mind controlled and turned into a loyal puppet.

Head of the Inou household during the foundation of the Empire over 2000 years ago, and a distant ancestor of Hotori and Kokuan. Despite his status, he's not skilled with the blade and instead leads the Inou family with his charisma and friendly demeanor. He acted as a comrade and later first friend of Mitsurugi.
At an unknown point in time, he's murdered by Kahaku, who then impersonates him.
Favourite: Persimmon

A shrine maiden of the Shiinoha family, a long-standing lineage of Shinto priests whose history predates the founding of the Empire by Himi-no-Mikoto. She is also a distant ancestor of Shiinoha Kotone.
She was once caught up in an incident while the capital guards were pursuing a fugitive, and was rescued by Mitsurugi, the hero who saved the nation.
Through this connection, she became Mitsurugi’s personal shrine maiden.

Cheerful and optimistic by nature, she was later recognized by Himi-no-Mikoto and appointed as the first Exalt-Priestess. Together with Mitsurugi, she faced the great crisis that threatened the Empire.
Favorite: Miso soup
A shrine maiden who holds the position of Kanchō, the head priestess overseeing all Shinto affairs in Iseno. She is exceptionally serious and highly capable.
Since the Sai-Miko (Imperial Shrine Maiden) often resides at the Imperial Sanctuary in Tenkyo, she is responsible for managing Iseno, home to the largest shrine in the Imperial Nation.
She has been close friends with Kotone since their school days and recognizes her talent more than anyone else.
Though often exasperated by Kotone’s free-spirited nature—frequently scolding her and reining her in—at her core, she is committed to supporting Kotone to the very end.
Favourite: Peach

A distant ancestor of Miyakuni Akari, she was the first emperor to unite the many factions that formed the Imperial Nation. Originally the ruler of a small kingdom, she rose to prominence through her unmatched skill in sorcery and her remarkable charisma, ultimately becoming the leader of a unified realm. The sword, mirror, and magatama bestowed upon her by the Ōmikami are revered as sacred Treasures said to protect the Imperial Nation. Her fondness for peaches led to the peach becoming the national flower. Even in the present day, long after peace has returned to the Imperial Nation, she still resides within Akari, seemingly bound by lingering regrets she cannot release.
